chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, Sayyid al-ʿĀbidīn, عليه السلام, said:
Whoever marries for the sake of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and to uphold kinship ties, Allah, the Exalted, will crown him with the crown of sovereignty and honor.

key_terms.تَاجِ الْمُلْكِ: a crown of sovereignty or noble rank
key_terms.صِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ: maintaining bonds of kinship and family ties
key_terms.لِلَّهِ: for the sake of Allah, with sincere intention

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for marrying for the sake of Allah and maintaining kinship ties?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that marriage, when undertaken sincerely for Allah and for maintaining ties of kinship, carries great spiritual merit. It presents marriage not merely as a personal act, but as an act of devotion and family responsibility rewarded by Allah with honor and dignity.
